title: Sunset configuration (.sunset.yml)
description: Every key is optional. CLI flags and Action inputs override these values. docs/configuration.md describes each key.

include.description: When set, only files matching one of these globs are scanned.

exclude.description: Files matching one of these globs are not scanned.

docs.description: Extra paths that count as documentation: model IDs there are listed as mentions and never fail a run. *.md, *.mdx, *.rst, *.txt and docs/** always count.

ignore.description: Findings to suppress. Each rule matches by path, model and rule; every key it sets must match.

legacy.description: Also report models the provider calls legacy, as notices. Default: false.

fail-on.description: The lowest severity that fails the run. Default: error.

fail-scope.description: On pull requests in the Action: all (default) fails on every finding at or above fail-on; new fails only on findings the pull request adds. Everywhere else, every finding counts.

registry.description: remote (default: the latest registry, falling back to the bundled copy), bundled (no network calls), a path to a models.yaml, or an https URL of a mirror.

max-file-size.description: Files larger than this many bytes are skipped. Default: 1048576 (1 MiB).

platforms.description: The platforms this repository uses. When set, registry entries for other platforms are ignored, so an ID served on several platforms gets the verdict of the one you use. When not set, platforms inferred from the dependency manifests settle IDs that several platforms serve.

paths.description: Path globs, relative to the scanned directory.

models.description: Model IDs as written in the code, registry model IDs or registry entry IDs.

rules.description: Rule IDs, with or without the sunset/ prefix.

until.description: The last day the rule applies (YYYY-MM-DD). After it, the rule stops applying and is reported.

reason.description: Shown with the suppressed finding in the job summary and the JSON report.
